minutes.headline: Zoning board granted a special permit for lot-size and front-setback relief to add a garage and accessory apartment.
minutes.summary: The board heard the Bates application at 508 West Townsen Road for a garage and in-law/accessory apartment on an undersized lot. Discussion centered on the Board of Health letter's room limit versus the four-bedroom septic design, and an abutter's drainage and sightline concerns. The board granted the permit with standard compliance conditions and a condition that the co-applicant sign the application. The Lunenburg Village hearing was separately continued to December 11.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for lot-size and front-setback relief so a garage and in-law apartment can be added at 508 West Townsen Road.
The permit is conditioned on Board of Health compliance and on the co-applicant signing the application, which was missing.
The board weighed the Board of Health letter's room limit against the four-bedroom septic design before voting.
An abutter asked about property-line distance, his view and drainage, and raised runoff pooling on his driveway.
The Lunenburg Village hearing was continued to December 11 at the applicant's attorney's request.

why_it_matters: Special permits for undersized lots set how much can be built near neighbors, and the drainage and septic conditions decide who bears runoff and wastewater risk on and next to the property.
An added accessory apartment can change how a lot is used and the property's assessed value, which feeds into its tax bill.
